brief:
Gaza's government media office director Ismail al-Thawabta warned of intensifying psychological warfare and systematic disinformation campaigns by Israeli forces, Shehab Wire reported. He described the alleged operation as a coordinated effort to spread rumors and false news across the Palestinian territory.

The director characterized the campaign as dangerous and part of broader Israeli tactics aimed at manipulating public perception and undermining Palestinian morale. He did not specify which particular claims or narratives he considered false, nor did he outline concrete steps the media office would take in response to what he described as the psychological offensive.
